findings.evidence: Signature, kill-switch and sanitization helpers exist but are not wired to callback/WebSocket routes; stream identity trusts client parameters.

findings.recommended_correction: Disable public/provider actions until signed callbacks, server-issued session tokens, authorization, rate/spend caps and redaction are enforced.
